title: 虚构预约：数字与未知项

input.text:
雾湾图书角是为本测试虚构的机构，不对应真实服务。请根据下列约定解释预约、核对和领取，不要把虚构规定说成现实政策。
提交申请：读者提交书名和联系方式。每场活动只有 8 个名额，提交申请不代表一定获得名额。
核对与确认：工作人员在申请提交后的 12 小时内核对名额和信息。只有确认通过后才发放取件码；取件码从发放时起 48 小时内有效。核对时限和有效期的起算事件不同。
领取与失效：读者在有效期内凭取件码领取，过期码不能领取。素材没有定义延期、候补、收费、退款、地点或真实日期。
解释遇到未定义事项时，应明确说资料未提供，而不是补造服务承诺。

dimension_notes.body: Check the supplied fact anchors and substance of every section. Additional real-world claims require independent evidence; word presence alone does not establish truth.
dimension_notes.hotspots: Check whether each actual label promises the material behind that entry. Do not reward a valid rectangle for an unrelated label.
dimension_notes.cross_page: Trace the selected label and the exact context actually sent. Check useful added explanation, preserved quantities and qualifications, and contradictions; repetition statistics alone are not a semantic verdict.
dimension_notes.instruction: Preserve the requested language and distinguish the fixed source, inference, fiction and unknown information. Do not invent references or verification status.
